prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.title: Prompt builder
prompt.help: Write in natural language what you want to achieve. Compo will turn that intent into a complete, reusable and verifiable prompt with local Ollama or, if no model is active, with a deterministic structure.

agent.label: Agent
agent.title: Agent Builder
agent.help: Describe the assistant you need and its context. Compo will build identity, mission, boundaries, procedure, response format and quality criteria.

skill.label: Skill
skill.title: Skill builder
skill.help: Describe the capability you want to create. Compo will generate a complete SKILL.md with activation, non-activation, workflow, output format, guardrails and human review.

title.label: Internal title
title.help: Short name to recognise the prompt.

task.label: Main task
task.help: Describe precisely what the model should do.
task.placeholder: E.g. Analyse an AI answer and detect errors, gaps and improvements.

context.label: Use context
context.help: Indicate domain, input material and professional situation.
context.placeholder: E.g. Use in courses for archives, libraries and documentation professionals.

audience.label: Audience
audience.help: Person or group the output is aimed at.
audience.placeholder: E.g. Information professionals with intermediate AI knowledge.

output.label: Output format
output.placeholder: E.g. Table with criterion, assessment, evidence and recommendation.

constraints.label: Constraints and quality criteria
constraints.help: Limits, tone, sources, length, checks and warnings.
constraints.placeholder: E.g. Do not invent sources. Separate facts and inferences. Add a reliability note.

purpose.label: Purpose
purpose.placeholder: E.g. Help analyse academic documents and extract relevant evidence.

role.label: Role and identity
role.help: Professional profile, tone and working approach.
role.placeholder: E.g. Act as a senior information professional with methodological judgement.

tasks.label: Main tasks
tasks.placeholder: E.g. Summarise, compare, extract concepts, detect gaps, propose questions.

inputs.label: Expected inputs
inputs.help: Information types the agent will receive.
inputs.placeholder: E.g. Pasted texts, notes, transcripts, references, converted PDFs.

tools.label: Tools or resources
tools.help: Allowed capabilities if the environment provides them.
tools.placeholder: E.g. Local search, file reading, table extraction, text comparison.

limits.label: Limits and guardrails
limits.help: What the agent must not do and when human review is required.
limits.placeholder: E.g. Do not invent citations. Do not replace legal or professional judgement.

agent_output.label: Agent response format
agent_output.placeholder: E.g. Diagnosis, evidence, proposal, risks and reliability note.

skill_name.label: Skill name
skill_name.help: Readable name. The technical identifier should be short, semantic, stable, lowercase, and hyphenated.

slug.label: Slug
slug.help: Safe technical identifier: short, semantic, lowercase, hyphenated, and preferably under 64 characters.

description.label: Activation description
description.help: Semantic capability description. For skills, it must help Claude decide when to activate it: what it does and which user requests should trigger it.
description.placeholder: E.g. Optimizes prompts for Claude by reducing tokens without losing meaning, structure, or output quality. Use when the user asks to shorten, compact, refine, compress, or improve an instruction, prompt, agent, or skill.

activation.label: Activation criteria
activation.help: Natural usage triggers: words, verbs, tasks, and contexts Claude should recognize to activate the skill.
activation.placeholder: E.g. Use this skill when the user asks to draft or review an archival description.

non_activation.label: Non-activation criteria
non_activation.help: Cases where the skill must not be used.
non_activation.placeholder: E.g. Do not use to certify legal validity or fill data without evidence.

workflow.label: Workflow
workflow.help: Operational sequence the assistant must follow.
workflow.placeholder: E.g. 1. Identify description level. 2. Extract evidence. 3. Propose fields. 4. Flag doubts.

skill_output.label: Skill output format
skill_output.placeholder: E.g. Table with ISAD(G) field, proposed value, evidence, inference and confidence.

guardrails.label: Guardrails
guardrails.placeholder: E.g. Do not invent data. Mark inferences. Require professional review.

examples.label: Examples
examples.placeholder: E.g. Input: file transcript. Output: proposed descriptive fields.

prompt.label: Describe the prompt you need
prompt.help: Write a natural instruction. You do not need to separate role, context, format and constraints: Compo will do that for you.
prompt.placeholder: E.g. I need a prompt to assess AI-generated answers in courses for archivists and librarians. It should detect errors, hallucinations, weak evidence, bias and concrete improvements, with a final reliability note.

agent.label: Describe the agent you want to build
agent.help: Say what it should do, for whom, with what limits and in what context. Compo will complete the operating design.
agent.placeholder: E.g. I want an academic documentalist agent that reads long texts, extracts arguments and evidence, proposes analysis matrices and warns when data are missing or citations may be fabricated.

skill.label: Describe the skill you want to create
skill.help: Explain the capability the assistant should activate. Compo will generate a complete and reviewable SKILL.md.
skill.placeholder: E.g. I need a skill for ISAD(G) archival description. It should work with document transcripts, propose descriptive fields, separate literal evidence from inference, estimate confidence and require professional review.

portable.help: Generates the skill without references to Claude so it can be used with other assistants (ChatGPT, local assistants, etc.).

usage.title: Instructions
usage.subtitle: Brief guide for working with Compo local and Ollama.

quick.title: Recommended workflow
quick.step1: Choose Prompt, Agent or Skill from the top menu.
quick.step2: Write your need in natural language: objective, audience, context and limits.
quick.step3: Press Generate. If Ollama is active, Compo will use the selected local model; otherwise, it will create a fallback structure.
quick.step4: Review the result. Use Regenerate for a variant or Review for a critical audit.
quick.step5: Copy, download or export the project. When finished, press Shut down to close the local Compo server.

ollama.title: Ollama and models
ollama.body: Compo detects models installed in Ollama, lets you choose the active model and offers recommended downloads. For operational safety, Compo does not delete local models from the interface.

first_start.title: First start
first_start.body: For installation and first start, see the brief guide included in the docs folder.

safety.title: Safe-use criteria
safety.item1: Do not paste personal or confidential data unless the local context is appropriate and you are authorised.
safety.item2: Manually review prompts, agents and skills before production use.
safety.item3: Generated skills should be treated as operational drafts: check activation, limits, examples and guardrails.
safety.item4: Ollama is an independent service: shutting down Compo does not shut down Ollama.
